# Cairns Skin

> Cairns Skin answers the specific skin, skincare and non-prescription treatment questions people ask search engines and AI assistants. It is an educational resource, not a booking or e-commerce site, connected to Laser Clinics Cairns.

Every health and treatment article is reviewed before publication and carries a visible review status, evidence level and last-reviewed date. Content is written for Far North Queensland's tropical climate (high UV, heat and humidity) specifically, while staying useful for readers elsewhere in Australia. Treatment names and availability are pending confirmation against Laser Clinics Cairns' current service menu.
